Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the game. It was a close contest, but New Zealand won the series by 2-1. Fireworks are everywhere, as Kane Williamson picks up the trophy. Pakistan players have a bit of a rest now due to Pakistan Super League but New Zealand has an ODI series lined up against India on the 18th of January, Wednesday. It starts at 1.30 pm IST (8:00 am GMT). Do join us for the early build-up as well. Till then, take care and goodbye. Cheers!

Kane Williamson the skipper of New Zealand says that it was great to see Phillips play an incredible inning. Adds that there was a bit of an error in between but Glenn Phillips covered up for the team. Says that Glenn Phillips was playing his original game and he played an amazing knock and it feels great to win the game. Says that the surface was a bit competitive and good partnerships were all they needed. Ends by saying that they have had a fantastic time here and the support from the crowd was also amazing.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan is in for a chat. He says that they started really well and executed their plans really well. Although feels that they went on the back foot once Glenn Phillips came into the middle. Adds that he thinks the bowlers could not keep it tight in the end. Informs that he feels they were 20-30 runs short looking at the way Rizwan and Zaman were going on. Praises both the batters for their efforts in the end.

Devon Conway is the Player of the series. He says that the surface was quite batting-friendly and it helped him to score runs. Adds that it's a great feeling to win the series in Pakistan. Says that the skipper always kept on reminding him to play safe and score runs. Ends by thanking all the crowd and their supporters.
Glenn Phillips wins the Man of the Match award for his match-winning knock. He starts by saying he tried to play aggressively from the word go. Adds the intent was the key of his innings.
... Stay tuned for Presentations ...

Earlier in the match, Pakistan won the toss and opted to bat first. The decision seemed to be backfired when Pakistan lost two big wickets but Fakhar Zaman and Mohammad Rizwan steadied the ship for them. Fakhar Zaman (101 off 122) celebrated his 8th ODI hundred but lost his wicket. After their dismissal, Agha Salman played a good cameo, scoring 45 off 43 deliveries. New Zealand used only five bowlers and Tim Southee was the pick of the bowlers with his spell of 10-0-56-3. Lockie Ferguson scalped a couple of wickets whilst Michael Bracewell and Ish Sodhi picked a wicket each. Mitchell Santner was wicketless.

Pakistan was good with the ball but they lost their way in the end, and couldn't get the breakthroughs. It looked like they had the game in their hand but Glenn Phillips' quickfire fifty made it go them on the back foot again. Agha Salman was the pick of the bowlers for them as he chipped two wickets and was very much economical. Mohammad Wasim bagged two whilst Usama Mir and Mohammad Nawaz have one in their kitty. There were chances of run out's which Pakistan missed. Had they gotten those wickets, the result could have been different. They did manage to get two late wickets of Santner and Sodhi, but it was too little, too late for them.

An exceptional team effort from the Kiwis and it was a special knock from Glenn Phillips at the end that has handed them a series win here. They started off well but lost Finn Allen opting for a risky single. Devon Conway and Williamson continued the good work with the bat and Conway was dismissed after his half-century. William followed the suit with another risky single after scoring his 42nd fifty in the ODI. After Williamson's dismissal, wickets kept on tumbling for them and there were 205-6. Glenn Phillips scored a quickfire fifty and got New Zealand back in the driver's seat with Santner assisting him from the nonstriker's end. They stitched a partnership of 64 runs at the end.
Here are the winning runs! Mohammad Hasnain goes full and on the pads. Glenn Phillips stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket and gets across for one run. NEW ZEALAND WIN THE GAME BY 2 WICKETS.
WIDE! This a length ball, way outside off. It goes past the tramline. Glenn Phillips tries to reach out but misses. Wide called. SCORES LEVEL NOW!
A dot to end the over! It is full and on off. Southee tries to flick it away but it lobs to the off side off the outer half.
Tim Southee walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ish Sodhi tries to score the winning runs but holes out instead. It is full, on the pads. Ish Sodhi flicks it aerially towards mid-wicket. Agha Salman leaps and takes a solid catch near his chest. Mohammad Wasim gets his second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Agha Salman b Mohammad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: LEG BYE! This is full, angled into the pads. Glenn Phillips ends up playing all around it. It goes to the off side off the pads. They take a leg bye.
It is full, on middle and leg. Glenn Phillips whips it through mid-wicket along the ground. They take two runs.
Length and on off, defended out watchfully.
TWO LEG BYES! It is full, on the pads. Glenn Phillips looks to flick it away but misses. It goes to the leg side off his pads. They collect two leg byes.
Three dots in a row to end the over! Mohammad Hasnain fires in a yorker-length delivery. Sodhi digs it back to the bowler in time.
Mohammad Hasnain serves it full, in line with the stumps. Ish Sodhi steps forward and taps it to mid off.
This is overpitched wide outside off. Ish Sodhi tries to chase it but misses.
WIDE! It is full, spilled down leg. Ish Sodhi tries to flick but misses. The umpire signals a wide. 7 more runs needed.
Full and on leg, flicked to mid-wicket.
TWO BYES! Misses everyone. It is full, sliding down leg. Ish Sodhi moves to thaat side and tries to whip it away but gets beaten on the inside edge. The keeper misses it as well. They take two byes.
NO BALL! A Free Hit to follow. A lenght ball, on off. Glenn Phillips taps it to covers and takes a single. The umpire signals a no ball for overstepping.
A short one, outside off. Glenn Phillips cuts it to point.
On the pads, Ish Sodhi nudges it to mid-wicket. Mohammad Nawaz ends his spell with a wicket to his name and he finds the breakthrough at a crucial stage. Is it a little too late though?
Floated and full, just outside off. Ish Sodhi drives it into covers.
Full and on off. Sodhi blocks it back to the bowler. He has to defends for two more balls.

OUT! TIMBER! Is there a twist in the tale? Mohammad Nawaz finds the breakthrough and gets rid of Mitchell Santner here. It is floated and on outside off. It grips and turns in off the deck. Mitchell Santner goes back and tries ot push it through covers but misses it completely. The ball sneak through to disturb the stumps.
It is short, wide of off. Glenn Phillips stands tall and cuts it to point for one.

FIVE WIDES! Freebies. It is full, spilled down leg. Glenn Phillips tries to sweep it away but misses. Mohammad Rizwan also fails to pick it up. The ball races down to the fine leg fence. Pakistan cannot afford to give away runs at this stage.
Mitchell Santner nudges it to mid-wicket off his pads. They take a single. Glenn Phillips is back on strike.

FOUR! There is no stopping Glenn Phillips here. It is overpitched, outside off. Glenn Phillips stands tall and lofts it over mid off. It goes away into the fence. Is the pitch behaving differently? Or is Glenn Phillips batting on a different deck altogether? He seems to be in rollicking form here.
A rare dot here! But Pakistan need a wicket here. It is a length ball, outside off. Glenn Phillips uses his feet and defends it back to the bowler.
Mohammad Hasnain serves a length ball, angled in on off. Mitchell Santner dabs it to point and crosses for a single.
FOUR! Mitchell Santner getting into the action now. It is fuller, sliding down leg. Mitchell Santner stays back and clips it through the gap at mid-wicket. It races away to the fence.
It is pitched up, outside off. Glenn Phillips drills it through covers for a single.
Hasnain serves it on a length, on leg stump. This skids through. Glenn Phillips stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket. They take two quite comfortably.
Two dots on the trot to end the over. It is full and outside off. Mitchell Santner eases it to backward point. 31 needed off the final 6 overs.
Flatter and on off, defended to the left of the bowler.
Darted on the pads, Mitchell Santner clips it through mid-wicket. The batters take a couple. This is really good running. 250 now up for the Kiwis.
LEG BYE! Nawaz serves it full, going down leg. Glenn Phillips fails to flick it away. It goes to fine leg off his pads. They cross for a leg bye.
Mitchell Santner now gets Glenn Phillips back on strike. It is fuller and on middle. Mitchell Santner flicks it past mid on and crosses.
Full and straight, on off. Mitchell Santner eases it back to the bowler.

DROPPED! It is bit short, outside off. turning away with some extra bounce. Glenn Phillips tries to cut it away on his back foot but only gets a thick outside edge. Mohammad Rizwan is unable to pouch it safely.

Slower one, full and outside off. Glenn Phillips stays back and knocks it through the gap at covers for two runs. Glenn Phillips gets his first ODI half-century. He knows that he still has a job to finish here.
Tosses it up, outside off, turning away. Glenn Phillips prods and tries to block it away but gets beaten.
Mitchell Santner now rotates the strike as he smacks this short ball towards point.
Short and on leg. Glenn Phillips pulls it to mid-wicket with a short-arm jab. They take a single.
Flatter and just outside off. Glenn Phillips knocks it to wide of long on. Glenn Phillips runs the first one hard and gets back for the second one.
A single to end the over! New Zealand now need 41 runs off 48 balls. It is a length ball, straying on the pads, Glenn Phillips nudges it to mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length, around off. Mitchell Santner stays back and works it to point for a single.
Haris Rauf fires it full, angled in on off. Mitchell Santner digs it out to point.
Full length, attacking the pads. Glenn Phillips flicks it to mid on for one.
This is punched to deep point off the back foot. They take a couple.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Haris Rauf goes full and outside off. Glenn Phillips stands tall and smacks it through covers for four runs.
A single to end the over! Pitches it up, full and outside off. Glenn Phillips drives it through covers for a single.
SIX! BANG! This should release some pressure. It is a short ball, outside off. Glenn Phillips stands tall and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
A length ball, on off. Mitchell Santner pushes it to cover for a single.
It is full, inswinger, on the stumps. Glenn Phillips dabs it out to mid on.
Mitchell Santner rotates the strike. It is a length ball, in the channel. Mitchell Santner knocks it through cover-point for one.
Mohammad Wasim steams in and serves a length ball, on off. Mitchell Santner presses forward and blocks it into the deck.
Powerplay 2 comes to an end! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the match. New Zealand need 60 runs off 60 balls now.
Bowls it fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips looks to drive it but the ball hits the upper part of his bat and carries towards the left of the bowler. He makes a diving attempt but misses. Close!
Bowls it fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips eases it to the man at extra covers.
Fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips taps it to short covers.
Bowls it on off, Mitchell Santner eases it to mid on, and scampers for a risky run. The fielder has a shy at the bowlers' end but misses.
Fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips taps it to point for one.
SIX! All the way. Fuller and on middle and leg, Glenn Phillips hangs back and launches it over deep mid-wicket for a huge six! Excellent timing on this.
Fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips taps it to covers for a quick one. The fielder has a shy at the bowlers' end but misses.
Outside off, Glenn Phillips cuts it towards deep backward point. The fielder does well at the fence as the batters collect two.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips lofts it over mid off. Babar Azam makes a diving attempt to his left but just manages to get his fingers on at as the ball races away fro the fence. Close!
Fuller and on off, Glenn Phillips blocks it to covers.

Mitchell Santner is the new man at the crease. Will he able to provide good support to Glenn Phillips in the middle?

FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Glenn Phillips rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Fuller and outside off, Glenn Phillips looks to play at it but misses.

New Zealand are falling apart here. They need Tom Latham and Glenn Phillips to stick around for long and take it deep. They certainly hold the key for the Kiwis in this chase. 100 needed off 87 balls now with just 5 wickets in hand.
Glenn Phillips walks in.

Lands it on off, Tom Latham defends it back.
Fuller and on middle, Kane Williamson eases it to mid on for one.
Bowls it on off, Kane Williamson defends it to short covers.
Fuller and on off, Tom Latham drives it to covers for one.

Turning away from outside off, Daryl Mitchell looks to block it but misses.

Drinks! A good and steady start from New Zealand and the match is evenly poised at this stage. They lost Finn Allen, but Devon Conway and Kane Williamson are looking good at the moment. Pakistan need some quick wickets to get an upper hand in the game. New Zealand will look to build up a solid stand. Let's see how the contest pans out. Agha Salman to continue...

Fuller, in line with the stumps. Kane Williamson prods and defends.
It is pushed through quicker, full and on off. Devon Conway paddles it down to fine leg for a single.
A length ball, close to the body. Kane Williamson dabs it to point.
Good length, on the pads. Kane Williamson hangs back and nudges it through the gap at square leg. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out in the deep.
Good length, in the chanel. Kane Williamson knocks it to covers with soft hands.
WIDE! A slower length ball, sliding down leg. Kane Williamson fails to glance it around the corner. Wide called.
A length ball, skids on, middle and leg. Conway stays back and clips it to the leg side for a single.
A length ball, around off, tapped to point.
FOUR! Smashed. Back of a length, wide outside off. Devon Conway decides to ride the bounce and does really well to get on top of it. He crunches it through cover-point for four runs.
Fuller and on off, Kane Williamson eases it to square leg. Ends with a dot.
A low full toss, on off, Kane Williamson taps it to the man at mid on.
This one lands down leg, Kane Williamson flicks it to the man at backward square leg.
Bowls it on off, Kane Williamson eases it to the man at mid off.
Fuller and on middle, Devon Conway pushes it to covers for one.

Fuller one on off, turning in, Devon Conway prods forward to block it but misses and gets a rap on his pads. A loud appeal but the umpire is unmoved. Babar Azam decides not to review it. Perhaps missing leg. Oh no, the replay showed three reds and Babar Azam looks unhappy now. Had they reviewed it, Devon Conway was a goner!
Slightly shorter and on leg, Kane Williamson eases it to short mid-wicket. Dot.
Kane Williamson is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pakistan have a breakthrough in the game. Slightly shorter and on off, Devon Conway eases it to covers and calls for one. Tayyab Tahir (sub) is quick to grab it and makes a direct hit at the striker's end. Finn Allen is short of his ground as the first wicket goes down here. He makes his way back into the hut!
Slightly shorter, and some extra bounce, Devon Conway fends it to point.
Pitched up, on middle, Finn Allen knocks it to long on for one.
Bowls it on off, Finn Allen cuts it to point for a brace.
FOUR! Fine shot. On a length and on off, Finn Allen stands tall and drives it through extra covers for a boundary.
Bowls it on leg, Devon Conway flicks it but finds the man at backward square leg. Mohammad Wasim comes into the attack now.
Similar to the last delivery, Devon Conway drives it to the mid off fielder again.
Bowls it on off, Devon Conway drives it to the man at mid off.
Bowls it on middle and leg, Finn Allen flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on middle, Finn Allen prods forward and blocks it back.
Slightly shorter and on off, Devon Conway knocks it towards mid on for a single.
Mohammad Nawaz comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Slightly shorter and on off, Finn Allen hangs back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket for a boundary!
A low full toss and just outside off, Finn Allen looks to block it but misses. Close!
Slightly shorter and on off, Finn Allen eases it to short covers.
Good length, angling in, and some extra bounce, Devon Conway fends it to square leg for one.
Around the wicket. Fuller and on off, Devon Conway eases it to the man at mid off.
Lands it down leg, Devon Conway eases it to the man at short fine leg. Dot.
FOUR! Excellent placement. Bowls it on just outside off, Finn Allen rocks back and drives it through extra covers for a boundary.
Touch fuller and on middle, Devon Conway nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter one, slower too. Devon Conway taps it to the man at mid on.
On a length and on off, Devon Conway punches it to the man at mid off.
Fuller and on off, Finn Allen knocks it to mid off for a quick single.
On a length, and some extra bounce, Finn Allen punches it to the man at mid off.
FOUR! Excellent timing on this. Fuller and on off, Devon Conway hangs back and drives it handsomely through covers for a boundary.
Similar to the last delivery, this is again driven towards the mid off fielder.
Fuller and on off, Devon Conway drives it but finds the man at mid off.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow. Fuller and on middle, Devon Conway drills it straight down the ground as the ball races away from the fence in no time.
Bowls it on off, Devon Conway eases it to the man at mid off
On a length and outside off, Devon Conway leaves it alone.
Bowls it on a length and on middle, Devon Conway flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers through for a quick single.
Fuller and on middle, Devon Conway blocks it back towards the bowler again.
Good length and on off, Devon Conway eases it back towards the bowler.
Fuller and on off, Devon Conway taps it to the man at point.
Fuller and on middle and leg, Finn Allen eases it to mid on for one.
On a length, angling in, Finn Allen blocks it off his back foot.
FOUR! Connects it well finally. Fuller and on off, Devon Conway hangs back and caresses it though extra covers for a boundary! The fielder makes a good attempt to stop it but fails.
Bowls it fuller and outside off, Devon Conway looks to drive it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and on off, Devon Conway blocks it back.
Fuller and outside off, Devon Conway looks to drive it but misses.
On a length, some extra bounce, shaping in, Finn Allen fends it to square leg for one.
On a length and outside off, Finn Allen gets in two minds but leaves it alone in the end.
Wide! This one lands down leg, Finn Allen looks to flick it but misses.
Good length, shaping away, Devon Conway shoulders arms at it. Ends with a dot.
Fuller and on off, Devon Conway looks to drive it but miscues it back towards the left of the bowler. Dot.
On a length and on middle and leg, Finn Allen flicks it towards backward square leg. The fielder makes a good stop diving to his right. They cross.
Fuller and on off, Finn Allen blocks it back towards the bowler again.
Another one on off, angling in, and some extra bounce. Finn Allen fends it back towards the bowler.
On a length, some extra bounce, Finn Allen blocks it to mid off. A dot to start with.
Haris Rauf to steam in from the other end.
On a length and outside off, Finn Allen looks to drive it but edges it towards third man for a single.

This one lands down leg, Finn Allen looks to flick it but gets a rap on his pads. A loud appeal was turned down and Pakistan doesn't opt for a review! The replay shows that it was missing leg. Good decision.
Fuller one on middle, Finn Allen blocks it solidly back towards the bowler.
Wide! Angles it wide outside off, shaping away, Finn Allen leaves it alone.
On a length and outside off, shaping away a touch. Finn Allen looks to cut it but misses.
FOUR! On the charge. Errs his line and bowls it on leg, Finn Allen flicks it in the gap through backward square leg for a boundary. Gets off the mark in style.
On a length, shaping it away, Finn Allen lets it go. Starts with a dot.
